author: GameSpot
description:
Can Xbox's new leadership team right the ship ahead of the transition to a new generation of its hardware? Lucy and Tamoor discuss.

Xbox's new CEO, Asha Sharma, got straight to work in trying to right the ship, making some changes to the brand and Game Pass, as well as signaling some shifts in ethos and strategy that will be crucial to the future of the platform as it moves into a new generation of hardware. The question is, can Xbox climb out of the hole its dug itself into? On this week's episode of Spot On, Lucy and Tamoor take a look at the state of Xbox and try to answer that question.
